Title: Changes are coming to the Azure Sphere SDK in the next release

Body.Content:
The next release of the Azure Sphere SDK will bring significant enhancements in response to great feedback from the community. If you already use Azure Sphere, you'll need to take a few steps to adapt.

Learn more about upcoming changes and steps to take.
